about: The priest drops a small particle of the consecrated Host into the chalice. He quietly asks that this commingling and consecration of the Body and Blood of our Lord Jesus Christ may avail us unto eternal life.

s01.narrative: The priest drops the particle into the chalice and says the prayer secretly.

s02.translation: May this mingling and consecration of the Body and Blood of our Lord Jesus Christ bring eternal life to us who receive it. Amen.

w004.function: The second of two singular subjects of “fiat” (w012), which also remains singular.
